annotations.title: Full details of one Homedex home

description: The full details of one home by the id that search returned (its Homedex number, e.g. HX-CT20-00012), as text: price, rooms, description, the agent, when Homedex last checked it was still on the agent's website, and the link for viewings and enquiries, which go to the agent. Made for apps that use standard search and fetch tools (ChatGPT deep research); get_listing returns the same as structured data.
